goal: Review the local task-run manifest indexing and state traceback wiring fixes for exact set semantics, fail-closed behavior, finalization order, and bounded claims

supplied_material: Work object: authorized local RV64 development workspace AI evidence workflow only; no network, remote host, account, credential, third-party service, or production RTL operation is in scope.

Root cause A: validate_state_traceback_payload passed a raw run_id to task_run_report_fields, whose argument is a task-run root; the fix constructs .github/task-runs/<run_id> before reading task-report.md.

Root cause B: the observability and trace contracts require top-level run-manifest.json in evidence_assets, while index-evidence previously accepted only ordinary /evidence/ assets; the fix admits only the exact path .github/task-runs/<run>/run-manifest.json in addition to ordinary assets.

Aggregation contract: evidence-index.md and run-manifest evidence count, bytes, kind summary, and list remain ordinary-assets-only; the canonical manifest is a DB trace pointer and is excluded from these aggregates.

Runtime validator contract: ordinary DB rows must equal manifest asset_count, the canonical manifest must have exactly one row with kind=json, no other non-ordinary path is allowed, and total DB rows must equal ordinary+1.
Schema fact: evidence_assets.path is TEXT PRIMARY KEY, so a duplicate path cannot satisfy an exact row-count check while hiding a missing distinct path.

github-index behavioral probes cover two consecutive indexes, manifest SHA/size refresh without duplicates, manifest deletion cleanup, peer-run isolation, restoration, and render-manifest then index then validate ordering; temporary fixture Markdown is archived before DB-first audits.
agent-system behavioral probe builds an in-memory completed seven-state report and calls validate_state_traceback_payload with run_id, requiring no errors and current_state=persist.

Forward test 1: github-index profile run 2026-07-22-agent-system-observability-run-manifest-revtag-v9f completed 1/1; targeted artifact/trace/state audits all PASS with manifest ordinary asset_count=2 and DB rows=3.

Forward test 2: agent-system profile run 2026-07-22-agent-system-state-traceability-observability-revtag-v9f completed 10/10; targeted artifact/trace/state audits all PASS with manifest ordinary asset_count=12 and DB rows=13.

A DB-only reindex of the associated finalized npc-dev V9F run also produced targeted artifact/trace/state PASS without rewriting its published evidence-index; this is a backfill demonstration, not an automatic historical migration claim.

Two earlier github-index runs remain blocked evidence: the first exposed a fixture missing the production db.raw_evidence_index_only policy and unarchived fixture Markdown; the second had a PASS node but correctly failed overall because its task slug lacked an independent non-history focus. Neither is counted as completion evidence.

Claim boundary: only a conforming run whose manifest is finalized and then reindexed may claim DB = ordinary_assets union exactly one canonical run-manifest.json; historical runs are not automatically migrated, and DB count greater than or equal to manifest count is not accepted as consistency proof.
Production RV64 Verilog files were not modified by this workflow fix; architecture-stable remains GAP with 41 blockers and PPA remains UNQUALIFIED/promotion_eligible=false.

Review for counterexamples involving duplicate paths, extra top-level pointers, stale metadata, deleted manifest rows, cross-run cleanup, post-index manifest mutation, non-final historical runs, and state report path selection. Do not infer broader RTL, system, PPA, or historical migration claims.

deliverables: Return JSON only with verdict PASS or GAP, blocker_counterexamples, residual_risks, accepted_claim, and rejected_overclaims
success_criteria: PASS only if the stated exact-set invariant and state traceback path selection are supported by the supplied implementation and forward-test facts
Any plausible blocker-level counterexample within the frozen final-state scope must produce GAP
Historical migration, arbitrary DB surplus, production RTL closure, full-core arch-stable, or PPA promotion must remain rejected overclaims
